scope: First study export, evaluation, verifier and resource-probe code; does not cover the later direct-study verifier
summary: No actual logic/security defects, heldout fitting/reselection, invalid metric formulas, or false quality claims found. Verified non-payload binding hashes, preservation of all 289 original binding entries, dev-only model locking before calibration, 258,912-parameter ONNX structure, saved-logit metric and baseline-control reconciliation, and Torch-free runtime dependencies. Four bounded software tests passed. Accepted recall of 4/171 dev and 3/100 calibration is a research-quality failure, not a code bug; reference and speaker-identity uncertainties remain explicit. Final replay, full verification, and resource measurements remain the parent's responsibility. No repository edits or audio decoding/inference performed.
